pins.definition: To lower oneself into a sitting position, usually on a chair or seat.
To rest on a chair, sofa, or other surface in a seated position.
To be in a seated position, such as on a chair or on the ground.

situation: A weary traveler rests on a wooden bench at a quiet bus stop.
subject: the seated position
brief: A middle-aged man sits squarely on a weathered wooden park bench under a slanted shelter, his hands resting on his knees and his weight fully settled down. The seat takes the center of the frame, firmly supporting him against a pale yellow wall.
prompt: A middle-aged man sits squarely on a weathered wooden park bench under a slanted shelter, his hands resting on his knees and his weight fully settled down. The seat takes the center of the frame, firmly supporting him against a pale yellow wall. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.

notes: es-ES «sentarse»: To lower oneself into a sitting position, usually on a chair or seat.
de-DE «sitzen»: To rest on a chair, sofa, or other surface in a seated position.
ru «сидеть»: To be in a seated position, such as on a chair or on the ground.
